description: Müller, Viktor Paul and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. The actual Excel macro-enabled workbook projects long-term energy demand by sector and fuel. It combines top-down socioeconomic drivers with detailed bottom-up sectoral inputs and supports country-specific scenarios. The source identifies open data and includes a source-list workbook plus case-study archive. A native isNewVersionOf relation links an earlier deposit; it is treated as the same model lineage, not a new independent implementation. Specific country calibrations and uncertainty methods are not specified in the brief description. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of cc-by-4.0. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance.
